zoe_ops: Quick sync — Bluehawk Corp (dedicated) bring-up scheduled Thu 2025-02-06 22:00 UTC. Need final quota plan, autoscale thresholds, and a green run for the load test. Renewal risk if we miss SLA; flagging now. Ticket INC-8452. Who's oncall for the run?

sana_cs: I can own customer comms + enablement. Can we confirm expected peak RPS and warmup cadence? Bluehawk told us target is ~1.2k sustained RPS with p95 < 350ms.

luis_se: Proposed infra: reserve 8 GPUs (A100-80GB equiv) — pool id pool-3421. Autoscale knobs: min=6, max=12, step=2, target_util=0.7. Need token/sequence profile from the workload (avg tokens ~60, 99th ~300). Which model variant are we pinning?

raj_sre: From infra side — pool-3421 provisioning request submitted. capacity-bot: provisioning accepted (see below). I'll be available for smoke and metrics.

capacity-bot: Provisioning accepted — pool: pool-3421, slot-prefix: p-3421-*, ETA ~40m. Note: burst credits limited to 20% of reserved throughput.

luis_se: Load test (local loadgen) — use this to simulate shadow traffic:
```
loadgen --target bluehawk --pool pool-3421 \n  --rps 1200 --duration 15m --concurrency 64 \n  --model redwood-7b --max-tokens 512 --seed 42
```
Include KV-priming step 5m before start.

zoe_ops: :eyes: Can we schedule a shadow run Tue 20:00 UTC (customer in APAC will verify morning metrics)? Also need runbook link for on-call and fallbacks: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/dedicated-bringup 

sana_cs: I'll run the enablement call Wed 14:00 PT and walk them through quickstarts + failover testing. Adding agenda to calendar and will capture feedback.

raj_sre: I'll watch prometheus + jaeger traces during loadtest. If p95 > 350ms we'll roll 10% traffic to fallback model redwood-7b-quant and engage autoscale step immediately.

luis_se: Small config snippet for priming + autoscale I pushed to the ticket:
```yaml
autoscale:
  min_instances: 6
  max_instances: 12
  scale_step: 2
  target_utilization: 0.7
priming:
  kv_prime: true
  prime_duration: 300s
```

zoe_ops: :thumbsup: Thanks all. luis & raj — please post final knob values and load run results here by EOD tomorrow. sana — I'll send invite to Bluehawk and include post-call survey to capture enablement feedback. capacity-bot: please ping when pool is live.
